_comment: Every sprite sheet (.anim.json) of samples/aetherbound, the profile it is judged by, the flaws it is allowed to keep (each with a reason and a cap, so it cannot grow), and its visual review. `python3 tools/spritekit/validate.py --manifest tools/aetherbound/sprites.json --engine build/fengine_headless` must pass; see tools/spritekit/README.md. A waiver that starts 'Known debt' is a flaw to remove the next time its generator is touched: fix it, then delete the waiver. The 'character' profile below is SPEC.md's clip table as the checks read it: the game's actors.lua, field.lua and battle/scene.lua rely on these names, on the 'step' events and on 'hit' landing 0.24 s into 'attack'.

pixels.edge.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: a scabbard, weapon tip or (in 'thrown') a limb reaches the last row of its 64 x 64 frame in 8 frames, so the engine's outline (battle/scene.lua puts one on Rowan) is cut there. Fix in tools/aetherbound/sprites/render.py: the ground row GROUND = 60 leaves three rows under the origin and tips hang lower; raise GROUND by one row (and keep the pivot on the soles), or lay the frames out with spritekit.tools.trim_and_centre(frames, margin=1).

pixels.bleed.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: the frames below those of pixels.edge have that tip right against their top edge in the atlas, and with the outline on it shows as a stray dot above the figure (seen in the review's outlined engine shot of Darius). Goes away with pixels.edge; generate.py could also pack with a 1 px gutter (spritekit.tools.pack).

pixels.pinholes.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: one-pixel holes where two parts of the ray-cast figure meet (arm against body, weapon against hand, under the crest), one or two in about a fifth of the frames; the ground flickers through as clips play. Fix in tools/aetherbound/sprites/framer.py render_frame: spritekit.tools.fill_pinholes(rgba, 1) after pixel.outline.

pixels.near_duplicates.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: tones computed per material land within a few steps of each other (#4a2a20 and #482a22, #fff0b0 and #fff4b0). Fix in tools/aetherbound/sprites/rig.py (the palette PAL): give the ramps that collide one shared tone, or run spritekit.tools.merge_near_duplicates over the frames in generate.py.

motion.baseline_pop.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: the kneeling poses ('kneel', 'critical', 'hold') touch the ground 3 to 4 px above the idle ground row, so the figure lifts off its shadow when it drops to a knee. Fix in tools/aetherbound/sprites/clips.py: 'hold' is posed with lift=5.0 and the kneeling poses do not bring the knee down to render.GROUND; pose them on the ground, or spritekit.tools.align_baseline(frames, row) per direction in generate.py.

motion.baseline_jitter.reason: Known debt from before spritekit: 'rise' goes from lying to one knee to standing and its kneeling frame floats 3 px above the other two (the same pose as 'kneel'; see motion.baseline_pop). Fix with it in tools/aetherbound/sprites/clips.py.
